# Lumi Local

> Done-for-you online presence for Vietnamese local businesses.

Official page: https://local.runlumi.app/

## Current offer

- Trust Kit: 399,000 VND one-time.
- Lumi Local Starter: 1,990,000 VND for year one.
- Trust Kit is fully credited if upgrading to Starter within 30 days.
- Renewal: 599,000 VND/year with a RunLumi Address or 999,000 VND/year with one standard custom domain.
- Lumi does not require Google Business Profile edit access for this offer.
- Lumi does not guarantee Google ranking, leads, customers or revenue.
